item_name: Rothco Firetec Interchangeable Sport Glass Lens System
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Firetec Interchangeable Sport Glass Lens System is designed for maximum adaptability and comfort. This versatile eyewear system includes three interchangeable lenses—smoke, yellow, and clear—allowing you to quickly adjust to changing light conditions. The durable nylon frame and soft nose piece provide a comfortable, secure fit during extended use. With an adjustable and detachable strap, these glasses offer a customizable fit for any activity.
description: Rothco’s Firetec Interchangeable Sport Glass Lens System is designed for maximum adaptability and comfort. This versatile eyewear system includes three interchangeable lenses—smoke, yellow, and clear—allowing you to quickly adjust to changing light conditions. The durable nylon frame and soft nose piece provide a comfortable, secure fit during extended use. With an adjustable and detachable strap, these glasses offer a customizable fit for any activity. The system also includes a microfiber pouch for cleaning and storage, as well as a foam-padded zippered carry case to keep your lenses and frame protected. Whether for outdoor sports, driving, or work, the Firetec system provides superior functionality and comfort.
